- Referrer-Policy

- HTTP/2 support
- Gzip compression
- SSL session cache
- Proxy buffering

- Let's Encrypt certificate setup script
- Automatic renewal (cron daily at 3 AM)
- Production deployment script
- Comprehensive documentation
